local_checks.invariant: TerminalInputGuard mode bytes are fixed crossterm commands and are not built from task, title, env, or paste text.
local_checks.result: requested_terminal_input appends only MouseCapture, BracketedPaste, and FocusChange, plus KeyboardProtocol when the bool is true. enable_capability and disable_capability match those variants to fixed crossterm commands. No arm reads task text, title, environment, or paste. enable_terminal_input is called once from run_board_loop. The in-repo test compares the literals ESC [?1004h and ESC [?1004l].

local_checks.invariant: A failed enable restores only successfully recorded capabilities, in reverse, and does not enter the event loop.
local_checks.result: enable_terminal_input_on pushes a capability only after enable_capability returns Ok. On error, Drop runs disable_all in reverse before the error leaves ratatui::run, so the event loop never starts.

assignment_note: Hunt whether focus-mode sequences include untrusted text or change command dispatch.
hardening: A capability is recorded only after execute returns Ok, and disable_all ignores disable errors. If the writer accepts a fixed mode sequence and then returns an error, Drop does not emit the matching disable. The board still returns before the event loop, and the sequence is not taken from task text.
